report.summary:
Patient P-D009 (73F, Medicare Advantage Lakeshore Senior PPO, home tract 17031720500) was seen at visit V-D009. Recent social-needs screener (2026-10-19) reported no current utility shutoff risk and no transportation barrier, but options were requested for utilities and transport. Eligibility noted where stated by the resource listings.

Utilities options:
- Shutoff Prevention Clinic: walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays. Eligibility not stated.
- Utility assistance pre-application: form to check what the patient qualifies for; response within one business day. Eligibility determined through pre-application.
- Neighborhood Energy Help: income-based help with gas and electric bills, apply in person Mon/Wed. Income-based eligibility.

Transport options:
- Senior Shuttle West: free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM. Patient (age 73) appears eligible by age.
- Paratransit Info Desk: ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. Requires ADA certification.
- Medicaid Ride Line: for Medicaid plan members; call at least 2 business days ahead. Patient has Medicare Advantage, not Medicaid, so likely not eligible unless dual-eligible (not indicated).
